themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, speeding up the development process.

themes.description: Covers the application of AI in various stages of the design and user research process, from ideation to validation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of artificial user representations or personas for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Articles that discuss using AI to analyze user feedback, reviews, and social media to understand sentiment and opinions.

themes.description: Covers the use of AI to extract actionable insights from customer data to understand behavior, preferences, and needs.
